protocol_amendments.stage: Before pilot generation; after protocol freeze
protocol_amendments.change: Corrected self-test expected connector count from four to five: one header rule, one KPI rule and three flow connections.
protocol_amendments.impact: Test assertion only. No generator prompt, renderer, quality rubric, task data or study condition changed.

protocol_amendments.stage: After all pilot generation finished, during judge collection
protocol_amendments.change: Added init --seed, positive brief-count validation and UTC creation date for future collections. Default seed and current-run creation date produce identical cases.
protocol_amendments.impact: Collection convenience only; no prompts, images, scores or model requests changed.

protocol_amendments.stage: Offline packaging, after all 132 calls completed
protocol_amendments.change: Preserve exact evidence bytes in Git and write derived notebook tables with LF line endings for portable replay.
protocol_amendments.impact: Serialization only; model inputs, output values and scoring remain unchanged.

execution: At most three independent CLI requests concurrently. Models return declarative JSON with tools disabled. No generated code is executed. PowerPoint rendering is serial.
output_policy: Preserve all generated scenes and rendered defects. Authoring-skill repair guidance is not applied to held-out experimental outputs, because that would invalidate the requested comparison.
